entries.name: ANSI/ISA-88 Batch Control (with MESA BatchML)
entries.publisher: International Society of Automation (ISA); BatchML by MESA International
entries.versionBasis: isa.org ISA-88 page lists ISA-88.00.01-2010 Part 1, -00.02-2001 Part 2, -00.03-2003 Part 3, -00.04-2006 Part 4 and ISA-TR88.00.02-2022; the MESA GitHub repo's latest release is V7.00.00 (2020-11-05).

licence.text: ISA standards are sold copyrighted documents; BatchML XSDs are under the MESA B2MML licence (use, copy, modify, redistribute free with the required acknowledgement)
licence.basis: Read the MESA B2MML-BatchML LICENSE on GitHub (permissive, with the acknowledgement 'The Business To Manufacturing Markup Language (B2MML) is used courtesy of MESA International.'); ISA's own terms page could not be found (isa.org terms and copyright URLs returned 404), so only the purchase listing was seen.

norn.overlap: recipes (general/site/master/control), equipment hierarchy, procedural model, batch production records

priority.reason: Recipes and batches for in-house manufacturing.

entries.notes: 'code-reusable' covers only the MESA BatchML XSDs (with acknowledgement); the ISA-88 prose is paid and reference-only. The BatchML repo has had no push since 2023-08.

entries.name: ISA-95 enterprise-control integration publications
entries.versionBasis: Series landing page lists multiple independently versioned parts; no single release inferred.

licence.basis: ISA copyright policy does not grant general republication of its standards; B2MML's separate grant is not a grant for ISA prose.

norn.overlap: Manufacturing resources, schedules, tests and performance; conceptual comparison only.

priority.reason: Production orders, routings and recipes are SAP PP table stakes.

entries.name: ISO 9202 Jewellery and precious metals: fineness of precious metal alloys
entries.versionBasis: Edition as listed in Norn-cloud/norn#351 research; the ISO page was not re-read this round.

licence.basis: iso.org refuses automated fetches; ISO publications are paid and copyrighted, and ISO terms forbid using ISO content for AI training or prompting.

norn.overlap: standard fineness values (parts per thousand) for gold, silver, platinum and palladium alloys

priority.reason: Precious-metal fineness and purity bounds; Norn records fineness as measured values.

entries.notes: Use only the published fineness numbers as facts (e.g. 750 for 18 ct gold); never feed ISO text to a model.

entries.name: ISO 14224 reliability and maintenance data availability
entries.versionBasis: Publisher lifecycle records publication 2016-09-16, corrected English version 2016-10, confirmed 2022; website copyright 2026 is not publication.

licence.basis: ISO requires written permission for reproduction; purchase alone is not redistribution permission.

norn.overlap: Equipment taxonomy, failure and maintenance data may guide a future licensed comparison only.

priority.reason: Production orders, routings and recipes are SAP PP table stakes.

entries.name: B2MML / BatchML ISA-95 XML implementation
entries.versionBasis: GitHub release published_at 2020-11-05T15:08:21Z; release implements 2018 ISA-95 changes, not a 2018 publication date.

licence.basis: LICENSE and XSD notice permit use, copying, modification and redistribution without fee with the specified MESA acknowledgement.

norn.overlap: Equipment, personnel, physical assets, material, operations tests, quality, schedules and performance remain source-owned shapes.

priority.reason: ISA-95 production orders and material lots.

entries.notes: Release notes label the accompanying JSON conversion untested; XML XSD is the selected artifact. Includes ISA-88 BatchML; no claim of complete normative ISA text coverage. Redistribution: license-conditions.
